ops.title: ccx Codex policy re-review: stale fallback bypasses tool revocation
ops.body: Independent re-review found one high-severity residual issue in cc-context. After a reflected tool is cached and then disabled in Codex, any later codex mcp list failure causes ccx to reuse the stale inventory, so the revoked tool remains callable even with CCX_EXEC_MCP=refresh. Installed Codex 0.155.1 supplied the allowed and revoked policy states; the deterministic outage leg reproduced the stale execution, while a healthy refresh removed the function. The attached report contains the exact trigger, impact, fix direction, evidence, primary sources, and limits.
